# Goal
kama lane (local model serving & endpoint health), round 33, attempt 1, WAVE 1 (build + falsify) — PREPARED, NOT DISPATCHED. The accepted host mapping has no task/AgentSwarm dispatch tool at this seat; the orchestrator dispatches prepared waves between rounds. Do not start until the orchestrator dispatches this exact wave.
Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin (jj-colocated; branch master). Work ONLY in this lane. Never mutate the fleet repo, sibling lanes, lane jj state or lane Git index; read-only git (log/show/diff/status) is permitted. Never add, commit, push, stash, checkout, switch, reset, pull or run a mutating jj command. Each writer receives its own separate worktree; use only that worktree and its assigned report path.
Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. Never message agent://all.
All reports/evidence stay under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-33/w1/out/. Do not edit shared lane files; return findings/proposals for the L1 integration owner. No fleet-root or sibling writes. Domain source trees are read-only.
# Declared claims
C1 calibration: KQ39 correction census for the three false round-32 Scorecard C2 gate-control references (frozen statement written at dc4258bdb08d658f1c5b15abc8378461659bd155): false_at_writing=3, valid corrections 0→3, unresolved=3→0. Counting command: `python3 tools/round33-claim-audit.py --repo . --statement-rev dc4258bdb08d658f1c5b15abc8378461659bd155 --tip <full commit>`.
C2 operability: complete replay receipts for the clean gate-tip and three named v2 controls: 0/4→4/4 receipts with pinned source/evaluated revisions and inline exit codes. The input gate source is round-32 revision 967d88528c1d83535563f971863f7855f76b4849. Counting command: `python3 tools/round33-gate-receipts.py audit --repo . --tip <full commit> --source-rev 967d88528c1d83535563f971863f7855f76b4849 --receipt-dir .ufo/waves/round-33/c2/final`.
# Round-32 routed defects
Attack the report-internal c2r receipt-lineage contradiction (receipt tip dc4258bdb08d658f1c5b15abc8378461659bd155, receipt commit 967d88528c1d83535563f971863f7855f76b4849); the three stale `*-v2.out` receipts that contain base-tree output; S193's docstring quote line/word count; and gate receipts missing full evaluated revision/inline exit code. Keep filed report bytes immutable; corrections append and name the superseded statement.
# Planner and role mapping
The L1 holds the canonical planner seat; the bounded plan/data walk is the preregistration and this spec. Do not add a planner role. The §3 floor is present: connector, executor, scribe, scout, reviewer and critic roles occur in this one batch.
Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in your report); install via uv tool/npx/an official binary in ~/.local/bin.
Pacman guard (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide until the operator resolves the host-recovery L0 question; never run pacman. If the pause lifts later, follow the dry-run rule in /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md and do not run a partial upgrade.
# Evidence limits
No service restoration, endpoint readiness, model quality, current registered-consumer health, or cross-lane scope transfer is claimed. Do not fetch or write external domain trees. A seat is a leaf; do not spawn subagents. A missing output is not a returned seat. The v2 gate fixtures are synthetic control inputs, not live serving evidence.
